name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 14 – Am 16
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 14a. Believes that, in view of rising living costs and their substantial impact on the lives of workers and their families, deepening inequality and social injustice, the persistently high level of poverty and social exclusion, the 2026 budget needs to allocate significantly more resources to the European Social Fund Plus, so as to help Member States address these challenges;
